[b]Corridor Trade Pact - Official Notice[/b]

The Corridor has remained deliberately restrained in its public communication over recent weeks. 

Since the first formal condemnation issued toward the Neue Republik, the situation has not stabilized. On the contrary, actions directed at Corridor member states have continued and escalated in both frequency and severity. These include the destruction of foreign property, repeated disruption of established trade routes, targeted attacks on financial and mercantile infrastructure, and direct military pressure against Corridor member states. In addition, the use of sanctions, embargoes, and actions that raise serious concerns regarding violations of basic standards of conduct have been documented and reviewed.

Taken together, these developments point to a consistent pattern that is incompatible with the desired economical growth and well-being of our member states. The Corridor cannot ignore sustained attempts to weaken its members anymore.

For this reason, the Corridor has, for some time, been actively considering economic retaliation as a proportionate response. That process has now reached its decisive stage.

As of today, a formal vote within the Corridor Council has been initiated to determine whether coordinated punitive economic measures will be enacted against the Neue Republik.

We have, and will always, stayed committed to stability through open trade and collaboration. However, those principles cannot be upheld unilaterally. We urge investors to remain vigilant in regards to the upcoming reactions and conclusions of the Corridor, on the matter.

Further communication will follow upon conclusion of the vote.
